motions.purpose: Fly a spacecraft along a precomputed 1200-sample lunar trajectory with a fading historical trail and predicted future path, to give the deck a cinematic orbital context slide.
motions.model: Playback of the local Lunaris prototype's trajectory data (orbit-data.json); spacecraft attitude slews by quaternion slerp, burn plume and bloom are visual effects; the Moon uses real NASA-derived textures with displacement relief.
motions.limitations: Not a mission ephemeris and not a propagation: samples are replayed as authored, burns are illustrative, and the gravity texture mode visualizes a field texture rather than integrating it. Never present as high-fidelity dynamics.
motions.reducedMotion: Playback freezes at the configured exportProgress with trail and caption visible; auto-rotation stops; the caption keeps reporting the sample index as text.
motions.exportState: ?export=1 or html[data-export="true"] freezes progress at exportProgress, hides the seeded star field and controls for a deterministic frame.
motions.accessibility: Space toggles play/pause, R restarts, Escape pauses; controls are native buttons with labels; telemetry (sample index, phase) is rendered as text; pauses automatically when the document is hidden.
